title: Let krn deliver bind from any checkout of the repository
body:
Defect: `krn deliver` binds by comparing the current checkout's HEAD with the PR head, so a first run from the main checkout fails with exit 71 "bind: local HEAD differs from PR head" (t-drwmtf8, PR #153, 2026-11-01; also t-37k23wh, PR #152). Running from the PR worktree binds, but hygiene then removes that worktree under the running shell (mise "Current directory does not exist", shell exit 1 after deliver exit 0; log .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/compact-window/deliver-1.log).
Outcome: one documented invocation from the main checkout delivers end to end: deliver resolves the PR head from GitHub and the local worktree that holds it (or fetches it), and never depends on cwd inside a worktree it retires.
Proof: a deliver test that starts in a checkout whose HEAD differs from the PR head binds by the PR head SHA and fails at the base by assertion; the krn-lead skill step 8 names the main checkout as the only start point.
